# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Rupee Panic`, a mobile-first portrait canvas arcade runner. Preserve the mechanics of a one-thumb horizontal drag runner: a centered player avatar follows touch/mouse x position with smoothing, falling hazards and collectibles spawn from the top, collectible collisions add 100 points, off-screen entities add 10 points, hazard collision ends the run, and restart begins the same loop.

The presentation should be a satirical Zelda-inspired cottagecore platformer arcade: pastel meadow, rupee goblin intern focal hero, cursed paperwork hazards, golden rupees, soft-girl UI panels, meme-tone copy (`vibes`, `its giving`), calming reset language, and fast onboarding for 4:7 to 9:16 mobile screens. Use browser-native canvas/CSS/JS and catalog-backed fantasy/comic fonts plus forest audio.

User steering prompt: Arcade. A satirical game inspired by Zelda built around platformer play, with creative, puzzle, satisfying energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like platformer, platformer, arcade, aesthetics like pastel dream, soft girl aesthetic, cottagecore, and meme-tone cues such as vibes, its giving. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a full-screen canvas arcade runner. The player horizontally steers a small avatar by mouse/touch drag while hazards and rewards fall from the top of the screen. Collision uses radial distance between player and entity centers. Rewards add 100 score and particles. Any hazard collision ends the run, hides the HUD, and shows a restart panel. Off-screen entities add 10 score. Difficulty increases every 600 frames by increasing speed and spawn cadence.

## Protected Mechanics
- Full-screen canvas runtime with start, active play, fail, and restart states.
- One-thumb horizontal drag/touch steering; no jump/combat input added.
- Automatic falling obstacles/rewards, 70 percent hazard / 30 percent reward spawn distribution.
- Circular collision threshold using player and entity width halves.
- Score semantics: +100 reward collection, +10 off-screen entity survival.
- Speed/difficulty escalation every 600 frames.
- Crash/failure immediately stops play and exposes restart.

## Rebuilt Identity
`Rupee Panic` reframes the same runner as a satirical Zelda-inspired cottagecore arcade platformer lane: the focal actor is a soft-girl rupee goblin intern sliding through a pastel meadow, collecting rupees while dodging cursed paperwork.

## Safe Presentation Transformations
HUD copy, title, player/hazard/reward silhouettes, procedural background, palette, typography, feedback text, and audio mappings are safe because they do not alter input, scoring, collision, timing, or state flow.
